# Frozen paths — Mission Control consolidation, ratified by the founder 22/10/2026
# ("commit to the consolidation"). Board ruling + reasons: 2nd Brain vault
# Wiki/nexus-mission-control/11-consolidation-recommendations.md and
# Decisions/2026-10-22-mission-control-consolidation.md.
#
# FROZEN = no new commits. Code keeps running as it does today; this only stops
# changes. scripts/check_frozen_paths.py fails any PR that adds, edits, renames or
# deletes a path matched below.
#
# To unfreeze: open a PR that changes ONLY this file. The guard reads the
# manifest at the PR's base AND head, so an edit here cannot unfreeze a path in
# the same PR that changes it. Deleting frozen code stays a founder decision.
#
# Syntax: one pattern per line. `*` matches inside one path segment; a trailing
# `/**` freezes a whole directory. Every pattern must match a tracked file
# (`--verify-manifest`), so an entry cannot go stale silently.
